name: Szentgotthárd (Hungary)
description: A vertical light grey banner with a white central panel, charged near the top with the town arms of Szentgotthárd (a crowned blue shield with a white charge, with red and yellow mantling) above the name Szentgotthárd.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentgotthárd arms with crown and mantling
